bull_case: AI-driven ad monetization, messaging/Threads monetization and new agent/enterprise products create more than one earnings path. The locked Bull value is about $1,091/share, 1.64x the frozen price.
bear_case: A prolonged AI-capex cycle, weaker ad growth, regulation and persistent Reality Labs losses can compress owner FCF for years. The locked Bear value is about $267/share, roughly 40% of the frozen price.
thesis: META has meaningful but not classic power-law asymmetry at its current scale. The harness Bull/current ratio is about 1.64x and there are at least two economically distinct upside paths, supporting a 75 upside-path score. A credible 5x path would require roughly an $8.5T equity value and is not treated as realistic. Balance-sheet strength lowers business-extinction risk, but valuation downside remains material and external large-cap base-rate evidence is limited.

evidence.claim: Locked harness scenarios imply approximately $267 Bear, $638 Base and $1,091 Bull per share versus a frozen $665.75 price; Bull/current is about 1.64x and Bear/current about 0.40x.
evidence.source: Harness locked owner-FCF/share DCF in META EV report

evidence.claim: Q2 2026 revenue grew 28% YoY while ad impressions rose 14% and average price per ad rose 12%, providing two operating drivers rather than a pure multiple-expansion thesis.
At June 30, 2026 Meta held about $90.26B of cash and marketable securities versus about $83.66B of long-term debt, while Q2 operating cash flow was $31.86B.

Q2 2026 free cash flow was only $0.784B and full-year capex guidance was $130B-$145B, showing that the downside path can be driven by sustained cash-investment intensity even with strong revenue growth.

A deliberately conservative illustrative probability set of 25% Bear / 55% Base / 20% Bull applied to the locked scenario values produces an expected value near $636/share, approximately the Base value and slightly below the frozen price; no external matched large-cap base rate was used.
evidence.source: Analyst probability calibration applied to frozen harness scenarios

counterevidence: A 5x equity-value outcome from the frozen market capitalization would require roughly $8.5T, so the classic outlier-return path is constrained by starting scale.
Q2 2026 FCF fell to $0.784B as infrastructure spending accelerated, making owner-cash-flow recovery the key assumption behind Base and Bull.
Advertising remains the dominant economic engine; messaging, subscriptions, agents and enterprise AI are not yet large enough to diversify downside fully.
Regulatory or platform-access shocks could reduce monetization without creating bankruptcy risk, so business survival and investment return are distinct.
unknowns: No clean historical base rate was frozen for how often companies starting above roughly $1.5T market capitalization compound to 3x or 5x within 5-10 years.
The maintenance-versus-growth split of 2026-2030 AI infrastructure spending remains undisclosed and materially affects the probability of FCF normalization.
falsifiers: Owner FCF remains structurally below $30B through 2028 despite double-digit revenue growth.
Ad impressions and price per ad both decelerate to low-single-digit growth for several quarters without offsetting messaging or new-product revenue.
Net liquidity turns materially negative while committed infrastructure spending continues to rise and operating cash flow weakens.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Frozen price $665.75 is well below the locked Bull value of about $1,091; the required veto element is false.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Meta has positive net cash versus long-term debt, very large operating cash flow and positive Bear-case owner FCF. Valuation drawdown is material but is not business-value extinction under the veto definition.

key_kpis.name: Ad impressions and price per ad
key_kpis.threshold: neither metric persistently low-single-digit or negative

key_kpis.name: Net cash versus debt
key_kpis.threshold: cash + marketable securities broadly cover debt or OCF remains clearly above refinancing needs

next_checks: Recompute Bear/Base/Bull probabilities after Q3 2026 capex, FCF and 2027 infrastructure guidance.
Collect an external large-cap 3x/5x base-rate dataset before raising probability_calibration.
Separate realized revenue from Threads, WhatsApp, subscriptions and enterprise AI to test whether upside paths are genuinely independent.

subscores.rationale: Bull/current is about 1.64x and at least two independent economic paths exist (core AI ad monetization and incremental messaging/new AI products). This matches the 1.6-2.5 with 2+ paths observable row. A 5x path is not assumed.

Bear/current is about 0.40x, near the lower boundary of the 0.4-0.6 band; band-centre interpolation is about 60 after 5-point rounding. Meta is net cash versus long-term debt and operating cash flow exceeds debt on an annual basis, adding the rubric +10 modifier.

Scenario probabilities and sensitivity are explicit, but no matched historical base-rate dataset was frozen. This is above purely narrative 50 but below the 75 anchor requiring base-rate/sensitivity support.

uncertainties.rationale: Starting market capitalization makes a true 5x path unusually demanding even though a 1.6x Bull path is credible.
Large committed AI infrastructure spending can impair owner FCF for years without threatening solvency.
Matched large-cap historical outcome frequencies were not available in the frozen evidence set.
